title: Very good, and can be better
body:
Overall the best habits app I found so far.

Some suggestions to consider: It would be great if the app allows you to search through your habits, also search the icons and adds more of them.

Also on MacOS app there's no area selection when create a habit and when managing areas it only allows you to select one optoin it would be great if you fixed this.
author: omar.masari

title: Simple and intuitive habit tracker
body: I’ve tried many habit trackers and this one is simple, nicely designed and has interesting graphs to follow your progress. Get it now!
author: Tomas Laurinavicius
